paper_title: New CAST Limit on the Axion-Photon Interaction
notes: CAST solar helioscope vacuum phase (2013-2015). World-leading limit g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 (95% C.L.) for m_a <~ 0.02 eV. This is a stellar/solar axion search (Primakoff), not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumption. Data points represent the flat low-mass limit; the limit degrades above ~0.02 eV due to loss of coherence. Exact mass-dependent values above 0.02 eV are only in Fig. 2 (plot).
